Great — thanks for confirming. Quick answers:
- Yes, bring your laptop; Python 3.10 is fine. We'll use the CoderPad environment for run / eval.
- Please avoid heavy external libraries (no PyTorch/TensorFlow imports); plain Python + numpy allowed. We'll run small snippets.
- Plan: ~35m coding (problem A ~20m, problem B ~15m), 15m design conversation, 10m Q&A.

Panel: Kimberly (pairing), Karthik (design), Laura (debrief notes), me (hiring manager). We'll aim to finish debrief in 10–15 minutes afterwards; Laura, I'll ping you in the Zoom chat to capture scores.

Sam — thanks again for coordinating.

See you at 09:45.
